description: Chrome + UI + speaker: localize the remaining chrome literals (audit C1-C17 + mastery labels), the six two-line game logos (audit §10.1), remove the Word Wizard speaker button (user request) and update the test it breaks, extract a shared StatChip for the streak chip (audit §8A), and remove the Number-Quest-only hero XP/level bar from the NQ home (audit §8B Option 1). Add the sound-toggle Hebrew widget test. Depends on FEAT-001 (keys/logos); independent of FEAT-002 in content but shares the Word Wizard screen and the NQ home file, so it runs after FEAT-002 to avoid conflicts.
steps: Sound toggle (plan.md D.1), lib/core/widgets/sound_toggle_button.dart: label -> soundOn ? context.l10n.soundOn : context.l10n.soundOff; import ../l10n/l10n.dart.

Pet round moment (plan.md D.2), lib/core/widgets/pet_round_moment.dart: 'Buddy' -> context.l10n.buddy; '🎉 Buddy grew!' -> context.l10n.buddyGrew; pass context into _grewBanner (or inline), drop const on the two Text widgets; import ../l10n/l10n.dart.

NQ parent screen (plan.md D.3 + D.5), lib/games/number_quest/screens/parent_screen.dart: import core/l10n/l10n.dart; AppBar 'Progress'->context.l10n.progress; stat labels -> nqHeroLevel/nqTotalStars/nqDayStreakLabel; 'Skills'->nqSkills; 'Tip for grown-ups'->nqGrownupTip; make _tip take BuildContext — default->nqTipDefault, weakest->nqTipWeakest(context.tr('nq.skill.label', weakest.name, weakest.label).toLowerCase()); _SkillRow: skill.label->context.tr('nq.skill.label', skill.name, skill.label), 'No questions yet'->nqNoQuestionsYet, '$correct / $attempts correct'->context.l10n.correctOfTotal(stat.correct, stat.attempts), stat.masteryLabel-> a new local helper _mastery(context, stat) mapping SkillStat thresholds to masteryJustStarting/Mastered/Strong/Practicing/NeedsPractice. Do NOT change skill.dart's masteryLabel.

NQ settings screen (plan.md D.4), lib/games/number_quest/screens/settings_screen.dart: stat line -> '⭐ ${state.totalStars} ${context.l10n.stars}   🪙 ${profile.coins} ${context.l10n.coins}   ${context.l10n.levelAbbrev(state.level)}'; reset dialog -> capture 'final l = context.l10n;' before showDialog, then resetConfirmTitle/resetConfirmBody/cancel/reset; drop const where a Text now reads a runtime string.

Two-line logos (plan.md E.1-E.6): in each *_home_screen _TitleBanner replace the two literal lines with the localized keys (nq/ss/ww/ch/mm/mem LogoLine1/2); make _TitleBanner non-const, add import ../../../core/l10n/l10n.dart if missing, keep font sizes/colors/rotation/shadows unchanged. Files: number_quest_home_screen.dart, shape_safari_home_screen.dart, word_wizard_home_screen.dart, clock_hero_home_screen.dart, money_math_home_screen.dart, memory_match_home_screen.dart.

Remove Word Wizard speaker (plan.md F.1), lib/games/word_wizard/screens/wizard_game_screen.dart: delete the _SpeakerButton render site (~205-209) and its adjacent spacer, the _SpeakerButton widget class (~255-285), and _speakWord() (~70-85). KEEP the _lang field + its initState assignment (still needed for question generation).

Remove the now-unused spokenWord getter (plan.md F.2), lib/games/word_wizard/models/word_question.dart: delete the spokenWord getter (verified used nowhere else). Do NOT touch FeedbackService.speak / SoundBridge.speak / maSpeak — leave dormant.

Update the broken speaker test (plan.md F.3): git -C <worktree> mv test/word_wizard_speaker_test.dart test/word_wizard_hebrew_test.dart; delete the first test (speaker-icon assertion); in the second test remove the three trailing speaker lines (find.byIcon volume_up, its expect, the tap) but keep the Hebrew-word + English-line assertions and the final takeException() check; update the top comment.

StatChip (plan.md G.1), create lib/core/widgets/stat_chip.dart: a comic pill matching CoinPill (white fill, Border.all(ink, 2.5), radius 14, comicShadow(offset:3), padding h12 v6) with a Row(mainAxisSize.min) of Text(leading, fontSize) + SizedBox(6) + Text('$value', w900). API StatChip({required String leading, required String value, double fontSize = 18}).

Replace bespoke streak chips (plan.md G.2, G.3): lib/app/game_hub_screen.dart _ProfileBar -> StatChip(leading:'🔥', value:'${profile.dailyStreak}', fontSize:15) (keep the dailyStreak>0 guard and trailing SizedBox, keep CoinPill after); lib/games/number_quest/screens/number_quest_home_screen.dart _Hud -> StatChip(leading:'🔥', value:'${profile.dailyStreak}'). Add stat_chip imports.

Remove NQ-only XP bar (plan.md H.1), lib/games/number_quest/screens/number_quest_home_screen.dart _Hud: delete the XpBar(...) line and its adjacent SizedBox; remove the now-unused XpBar import if nothing else uses it. Keep GameState hero-level logic; hero level stays in parent_screen. Spot-check (read) the other 5 game homes still render StarCoinHud + SoundToggleButton (no change expected).

Add test/sound_toggle_hebrew_test.dart (plan.md I.4): pump SoundToggleButton under L10n(lang: AppLang.he) and assert find.text('צליל: פועל') for soundOn:true and 'צליל: כבוי' for soundOn:false; English default shows 'Sound: On'/'Sound: Off'.
Run build web and the full test suite.
acceptance_criteria: In Hebrew mode the sound toggle, pet 'Buddy'/'Buddy grew!', NQ parent screen (title, stats, skills, tip, mastery, correct count), NQ settings stat line + reset dialog, and all six game two-line logos render Hebrew; English mode is byte-identical to before.

The Word Wizard speaker button, _SpeakerButton class, _speakWord(), and WordQuestion.spokenWord are gone; _lang stays and Hebrew question generation still works; FeedbackService.speak/SoundBridge.speak remain in the codebase (dormant).
A shared StatChip renders both the hub and NQ streak chips with CoinPill-matching styling; the NQ home no longer shows the hero XP/level bar and the other 5 game homes are unchanged.

The speaker test is renamed and trimmed and passes; the new sound-toggle Hebrew test passes; the full suite is green (89 baseline minus the 1 deleted speaker test, plus the kept Hebrew test and the new tests).
findings:
